reasoning_traces.think:
The core duality of data centers lies in the tension between resource consumption (energy) and public value creation (economic, social). The energy consumption \( E \) is modeled as a function of time, \( E(t) \), with a known trajectory from 2014 to 2023 and projections to 2028. The value \( V \) is derived from policy \( P \) and AI efficiency \( \text{AI}_{\text{efficiency}} \), such that \( V = \alpha E + \beta P + \gamma \cdot \text{AI}_{\text{efficiency}} \). The system's behavior hinges on \( \frac{\partial V}{\partial E} \), which must remain positive for net benefit. Failure modes include policy misalignment, where \( \beta < 0 \), or AI inefficiency, where \( \gamma < 0 \). The system is stable when \( \frac{\partial^2 V}{\partial E^2} = 0 \) and \( \frac{\partial^2 V}{\partial P^2} > 0 \).
